entries.zh: 丢放；抛到某处、丢弃（丢放棄）
entries.en: to throw something to some place; to toss away, discard
entries.notes: 汉字栏'棄/處'有疑标，依赖四栏互证定夺为'丢弃'义。

entries.zh: 掷落下来；把某物往下抛（擦落来）
entries.en: to throw something downward; to toss it down
entries.notes: 首字'擦/擲'存疑，按'掷落来'与西语 hacia baxos（向下）互证。

entries.en: to throw/cast it in some place; to hurl
to throw oneself/something into the water; to drown oneself
entries.notes: 闽南栏混入西语 alagua，17 世纪马尼拉语境常指投水（含自尽），语义以'投水'汉字为准。

entries.en: to throw oneself into a well; to drown oneself in a well
entries.notes: 闽南栏混入西语 alpoço（井），与汉字'投井'互证。

entries.en: to throw, toss (as wood/objects)
to throw away, cast off, abandon

entries.zh: 捻却摈；随手扔掉、撇弃某物
entries.en: to toss something aside, fling away carelessly
entries.notes: 西语 por tiendo 应为 por detrás 之类短语，展开依赖推断；汉字'摈/損'存疑。

entries.en: to throw down something; to lay aside
entries.notes: 首字'捺/换'存疑，按'放'与 arrojar alguna cosa（扔某物）定夺。

entries.zh: 放却摈；抛弃、丢掉（放却摈）
entries.en: to throw away, cast aside, discard
to throw away, toss out
to abandon, forsake, give up

entries.zh: 却丢；丢掉（承接上条省略'放'字）
entries.en: to throw away, discard

entries.zh: 拨却丢；拨开丢弃、抖落抛掉
entries.en: to shake/fling off and throw away
entries.notes: 首字'發/撥'存疑；按 arrojar abriendo（边打开边抛）与拨/发义互证取'撥'。

entries.en: to hurl, dash, throw (violently)
entries.notes: 汉字'撞/常'存疑，按音写 chōng 与 arrojar 语境定为'撞'。

entries.en: to throw away/off; to hurl it off

entries.zh: 撞上去；向上抛掷（撞上去）
entries.en: to throw/hurl it upward
entries.notes: 汉字'撞/常'存疑；闽南栏混入西语 aniba（arriba 之讹）。

entries.zh: 撞落来；向下抛掷（撞落来）
entries.en: to throw/hurl it downward
entries.notes: 汉字'撞/常'存疑；闽南栏混入西语 abayo（abaxo 之讹）。

entries.zh: 掷签；掷竹签占卜（掷载/签）
entries.en: to throw divining sticks/bamboo lots (to the mandarin's canes)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（mandarinong canas ¥ guoacufen），汉字'载/籤/戳'存疑；按'掷签'占卜义推断。

entries.en: to scatter, sow, spread (broadcast)
to scatter abroad, spread about
entries.notes: 汉字'摈/損'存疑；闽南栏 ia 与官话栏 pō 对音不合，按播字义定夺。

entries.en: to scatter, spread out; to disseminate
to sow (seed), scatter seed
to throw at, strike by throwing
entries.notes: 西语词头 baciendo, obot viendo 残损难解；汉字'到/倒'存疑，按音写 to 与掷击义推断。

entries.en: to throw so as to hit/reach
entries.notes: 西语 ut baciando 缩损；'挨/换'存疑，按 ta 音与挨义推断。

entries.zh: 扫除；扫除垃圾、清除废弃物
entries.en: to sweep away, clear out rubbish
